concept.reason: Real fossils, labeled CT anatomy and same-species complete reconstruction supply sufficient evidence.

scope: Complete Carboniferous trigonotarbid: compact pear-shaped outline, triangular carapace, broad divided dorsal abdominal plates and no tail. Based on actual NHMUK I.15860 fossil/CT and same-species idealized reconstruction.

scientific_limits.en: Published dimensions belong to scanned NHMUK I.15860, not the smaller holotype. Symmetry, absent distal limb portions, living posture and color are interpretations guided by the same-species reconstruction. No venom, silk structures or long tail inferred.
scientific_limits.zh: 公开尺度属于扫描标本 NHMUK I.15860，不是较小的正模。左右对称、缺失肢端、活体姿态和颜色为参考同种复原的解释；不臆造毒腺、吐丝结构或长尾。

scale.uncertainty: Body and leg4 values published for NHMUK I.15860. Depth and regularized pose inferred; do not use holotype4.8mm body or2.5mm abdomen width.

anatomy: Triangular carapace widens posteriorly with smooth unlobed sides, raised median ridge, small anterior rounded clypeus and close median eyes. Shallow inverted-T depression behind eyes joins rear transverse groove.

Broad rounded opisthosoma with central and lateral dorsal plates. Tergite1 is a ridge partly tucked beneath carapace; tergites2 and3 remain separate, not fused diplotergite; narrow tergite9 not laterally divided.
Four pairs of short robust jointed walking legs plus separate slender pedipalps and small downward-hanging chelicerae under clypeus. Pedipalps are not a fifth walking pair and not long antennae.
Leg4 proportions follow measured six distal podomeres; short metatarsus and longer tarsus. Coxae meet small diamond-shaped sternum; no large pedipalp pincers.
Ventral sternites curve backwards, especially posteriorly; sternites9+10 apparently fused with small ventral pygidium near their anterior edge. Pygidium is not a projecting external tail.
Generally smooth surface without major spines or pustules. No spider spinnerets, narrow spider waist, scorpion sting, Eophrynus spines or fused shield over all abdomen.
restoration_boundaries: Actual hand fossil panels in Figure2 and CT Figure3 specifically identify NHMUK I.15860; Figure4 is an idealized same-species synthesis using that scan and additional hand specimens. Do not call Figure4 photograph or complete preservation.
Holotype NHMUK In31239 is distinct and4.8mm long. Model anchors scanned6.3mm specimen; keep their measurements separate.
Late Carboniferous Coseley near Dudley, UK. Figure3 missing/irregular parts are taphonomic or segmentation artifacts, not living gaps.
Reconstructed symmetry and limb posture follow Figure4, not copied CT mesh. Living thickness estimated; muted color artistic.
Tergite1 ridge and narrow undivided9 prevent blindly making nine identical tripartite rows. Keep exact declared segment topology inspectable.
quality_gates: Original compact pear-shaped full animal, triangular shield, divided dorsal plates and no external tail.
Eight walking legs, distinct palps and small chelicerae; preserve short sturdy proportions.
Tergites2/3 distinct, terminal9 undivided, first ridge partly under carapace.
Actual6.3mm specimen measurements distinct from4.8mm holotype.
Four default views; inspect hidden underside in scene, no extra default render.
